name: DiffView
purpose: A split or unified source comparison with exact change counts and change navigation.
description: CodeMirror computes real line and inline changes. Red minus markers identify removals; green plus markers identify additions. The legend counts affected lines. Focus changes folds unchanged context, and Show all lines restores it. Split and unified layouts share the same documents and change navigation.

props.name: focusFirstChange
props.description: Scroll the editor to the first change without moving keyboard focus.

props.name: modifiedIntent
props.description: Marks provenance separately from green additions and red removals.

guidance.overview: A split or unified source comparison with exact change counts and change navigation.
usage: Supply original and modified snapshots. The default is readonly; enable editing only when onModifiedChange updates the host’s modified value.
collapseUnchanged reduces long unchanged stretches. focusFirstChange scrolls to a change without moving keyboard focus.
Use originalLabel and modifiedLabel to explain which version each pane represents.
accessibility: Next and Previous change controls move to meaningful change locations; Tab still leaves the editor surfaces.
Additions and removals are identified with labels and counts rather than relying only on green and red backgrounds.
intent: modifiedIntent="ai" labels provenance separately from addition and removal semantics; it does not approve the proposed content.
context: Use for reviewing configuration edits, generated proposals, and revisions before an explicit save or approval action.
